title: Laredo Youth Council Fundraiser Tuesday at Clementine's Kitchen
excerpt: The Laredo Youth Council holds a fundraiser Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. at Clementine's Kitchen, 3301 San Bernardo Ave., Unit 2. Proceeds help council students attend the Youth Advisory Commission Summit in February 2027.
content:
The Laredo Youth Council is holding a fundraiser on Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. at Clementine's Kitchen, 3301 San Bernardo Ave., Unit 2, in Laredo.

A portion of the proceeds will help Youth Council students attend the Youth Advisory Commission Summit in February 2027, where they will meet youth leaders from other communities and build their leadership skills.

The City of Laredo invites the community to enjoy a meal, support a local business, and invest in the next generation of Laredo leaders.

Source: City of Laredo.
